prompts.text: Generate an animated SVG illustrating a spinning supermassive black hole with an accretion disk and strong gravitational lensing in deep space using pure inline SVG animation (SMIL or CSS keyframes). The astrophysical scene must faithfully represent: 1. The central pitch-black shadow of the event horizon and photon sphere. 2. A radiant, high-temperature plasma accretion disk orbiting the black hole; due to extreme spacetime curvature (Einstein general relativity), light from the back of the accretion disk is bent upwards and downwards over the shadow, forming the iconic double-ring gravitational lensing crown. 3. Relativistic Doppler beaming: the side of the accretion disk rotating toward the observer is noticeably brighter, more energetic, and shifted toward white-blue, while the receding side is dimmer and shifted toward deep red-orange. 4. Accretion matter streams and spiral vortices continuously flowing into the event horizon, with swirling orbital motion faster near the inner edge (Keplerian differential rotation). Ensure the output is strictly well-formed valid XML SVG: wrap any <style> CSS in CDATA, do NOT use consecutive hyphens '--' inside comments, avoid duplicate attributes on tags, and self-contain all elements.
